name: phantombuster
label: PhantomBuster
description: Automate your web scraping and web automation tasks

token.label: API Token
token.description:
1. Login to your Pushbullet Dashboard.
2. Go to **https://phantombuster.com/workspace-settings**.
3. change to the **API Keys** tab and **Add API Key**.
4. Copy the API Key to the clipboard and paste it.

launchPhantom.label: Launch Phantom
launchPhantom.description: Launch a Phantombuster agent and add it to the execution queue

agentId.label: Agent
agentId.description: Select the Phantombuster agent to use

waitForOutput.label: Wait for Output
waitForOutput.description: Wait until the agent execution completes and output is available

argument.label: Argument
argument.description: Optional argument to pass to the agent

maxRetries.label: Max Retries
maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retries if the agent fails
